root_cause: The radios component only updates conditional visibility for radios with data-aria-controls on click events; it does not respond to changes in checked state via keyboard navigation, leaving conditionals visible when a radio without controls (e.g., opt‑out) is selected.
repair_strategy: Add a change listener to the radios module that invokes setAttributes on all radios with controls whenever any radio's checked state changes, ensuring conditionals are shown/hidden based on the newly selected radio.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can now navigate the radio group with arrow keys and see dependent fields appear/disappear correctly, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard), 2.4.3 (Focus Order) and 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value).
functional_risks: Possible duplicate execution of setAttributes when both click and change events fire for the same interaction.
If another script depends on the change event not being fired, adding the listener could cause unintended side effects.
Minimal performance overhead from traversing the radio list on each change event.
verification_requirements: Verify that selecting each radio option via keyboard updates the visibility of its associated conditional field correctly.
Verify that clicking a radio option continues to work as before.
Verify that ARIA attributes (aria-controls, aria-expanded) are correctly updated on both click and keyboard selection.
Ensure no regression in existing visual behavior for mouse users.
